description: Receive one complete evidence-backed Visibility Check per user for a business, its website and market. Requires the business's own website (not a social profile or link-in-bio page); ask the user for it before calling. Uses normal login, including consumer email. This is optional: a specific creator, video or export request should use its own action directly. Returns a durable operation; read candidate themes, continue with stored IDs, then retrieve the complete report. Failed or partial-only reports restore eligibility; reconnects for the same brand, market and platform reuse released work. If the free check is already allocated to a different brand, market or platform, status is complimentary_in_use: nothing new was started, so tell the user which brand and market holds it (operationId, locator, market) and never present that report as the requested one.

market.description: Country code for the audience being researched.

targetWebsiteUrl.description: The business's own public website, for example acme.com. Required; social profiles and link-in-bio pages are rejected.

workspaceId.description: Resolve the user's authorized workspace; reuse the only workspace without asking for its ID.

name: socialseal_start_visibility_check
title: Start a complimentary Visibility Check
